title: Is this change compatible?
description:
Write `bool breaksBinaryCompatibility(const std::string& change)` for a published C interface. These changes break programs already compiled against it:

`"remove a function"`, `"rename a function"`, `"change a parameter type"`, `"change a return type"`, `"reorder struct members"`, `"renumber an enum value"`, `"change a visible struct's size"`.

These do not, and return `false`:

`"add a function"`, `"add a result code"`, `"change an opaque type's members"`, `"add an enum value at the end"`, `"fix a bug"`.

Anything not in either list: return `true` (assume it breaks until you have checked).
hints: Keep the safe changes and the breaking changes in two sets. Return false for a safe one, true for a breaking one, and true for anything unknown: when in doubt, assume it breaks.
